articles.chapeau: GTA 6 est en vente en magasin depuis le 12 novembre : le code dans la boîte permet de télécharger les 200 Go dès maintenant pour jouer le 19. La Fnac, qui prépare ses stocks depuis le printemps, prédit un record.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 est en vente en magasin depuis le jeudi 12 novembre 2026, une semaine avant sa sortie, prévue le jeudi 19 novembre 2026. La boîte permet de télécharger le jeu dès maintenant, treize ans après GTA V, et la Fnac prédit un « lancement record » avec des précommandes au-delà des prévisions, Travis Scott et Justice sur la bande originale.
Take-Two, maison mère de Rockstar Games, a écrit lors de ses derniers résultats que les précommandes de GTA VI dépassent « largement » ses prévisions , sans donner de chiffre. Le code glissé dans la boîte s’active tout de suite pour précharger les quelque 200 Go du jeu.
Charlotte Massicault, directrice gaming et multimédia de Fnac Darty, prépare cette sortie depuis le printemps , a-t-elle expliqué à Capital ce jeudi. Le jour J, les Fnac des Ternes et de Montparnasse, à Paris, mettront le jeu en vitrine. Autre particularité, ce GTA 6 sans disque ne reviendra jamais en rayon d’occasion .
Difficile d’être catégorique, mais le 19 novembre, nous devrions assister à un lancement record.
Sony a sorti deux manettes DualSense aux couleurs de GTA VI, et la blanche est déjà épuisée en ligne et en magasin sur fnac.com. La noire, ornée de feuilles de palmier, reste en précommande sur la boutique de PlayStation.
The Album, la bande originale avec Travis Scott, Keith Richards et PinkPantheress, sort le 20 novembre , le lendemain du jeu, et la Fnac en vend deux vinyles exclusifs à 40,99 euros. La musique du jeu, signée Justice avec Tame Impala et SZA, suit le 11 décembre, à 44,99 euros en triple vinyle.
Le jeu fait aussi vendre des consoles et des disques de stockage , observe Fnac Darty. Une Xbox Series X 1 To coûte 799,99 euros chez Micromania, dix fois le jeu : pour les franchises de magasins et commerces spécialisés , c’est ce panier que le lancement amène en rayon.
Fnac Darty compte 380 magasins franchisés en France, presque autant que de magasins intégrés (398). Près de la moitié des commandes passées sur son site sont retirées en magasin, ce qui y amène aussi les acheteurs du web.

Chez Gamecash, 24 magasins franchisés ont lancé ensemble les réservations de GTA 6 dès le 25 juin , avec la même offre de fidélité. La centrale d’achat de ce réseau de franchises de dépôt-vente et d’achat-revente négocie les prix pour chacun et promet « un approvisionnement régulier en produits populaires et exclusifs », sur un jeu où l’enseigne annonçait des ruptures « quasi certaines ».
Carine Tortel tenait seule une grande surface spécialisée depuis près de dix ans avant d’ouvrir sous enseigne Fnac à Aubenas, en Ardèche. Seule, elle manquait de réactivité dans l’approvisionnement, raconte-t-elle sur la page de recrutement des franchisés Fnac.
La Fnac proposait une solution à l’ensemble de nos difficultés avec une notoriété incomparable et un concept de magasin adapté.

GTA 6 est désormais disponible en boîte, que contient-elle ?
articles.chapeau: Il est désormais possible d’acheter sa boîte de GTA 6. Une version physique qui laisse perplexe.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre prochain, mais il est d’ores et déjà possible de se le procurer. En effet, ceux qui ont précommandé le jeu sur le PSN ou le Xbox Live peuvent le télécharger depuis mardi dernier. Aujourd’hui, nouvelle étape commerciale puisque le jeu est vendu dans les magasins en version boîte.
Cette boîte ne contient toutefois pas de disque, bien qu’il y ait un emplacement pour. L’acheteur n’a donc qu’un bout de plastique entre les mains. L’intérêt est tout simplement de permettre au jeu d’être visible dans les enseignes, mais aussi de satisfaire les collectionneurs qui veulent absolument l’ajouter à leur ludothèque.
Rassurez-vous, la boîte contient tout de même le jeu. Plus précisément, un code à utiliser pour le télécharger sur votre console. Physique ou dématérialisée, il est donc impossible d’échapper au téléchargement des 212 Go nécessaires pour s’aventurer à Vice City. Une stratégie qui permet à Rockstar d’empêcher certains petits malins de jouer avant le 19 novembre, d’annihiler le marché de l’occasion, mais aussi de réduire les coûts de production. Eh oui, sans disque, la boîte coûte moins cher à produire, tandis que le prix de vente, lui, reste le même (80 euros). Une stratégie du tout dématérialisé que nous regrettons et qui va à l’encontre de la préservation du jeu vidéo.
Une fois le code en votre possession, il faut donc encore télécharger le jeu, qui restera inaccessible jusqu’au 19 novembre à minuit. C’est seulement à ce moment-là que l’accès sera débloqué… si les serveurs tiennent. Un lancement d’une ampleur inédite dans l’histoire du divertissement, qui risque de réserver quelques surprises. Le jeu bat déjà tous les records, dépassant même les attentes de Take-Two. Il aurait déjà été écoulé à plus de 7 millions d’unités en précommandes et aurait généré plus de 750 millions de dollars de recettes.
En plus du code, la boîte contient un fascicule permettant de passer à l’édition ultime à 100 euros, mais aussi un poster collector double face. Contrairement aux précédents jeux de Rockstar, pas de carte ! C’est bien dommage, tant il était ludique de l’admirer avant de pouvoir jouer.
OP can’t open the box as it’s taken from a retailer worker but there is a weight to the box which indicates it includes the poster as per reported. pic.twitter.com/EDT520ZXP7
Pour rappel, GTA 6 se déroule à Vice City et dans l’État de Leonida, des pastiches de Miami et de la Floride. L’histoire se concentrera sur Jason et Lucia, un couple de braqueurs qui doit naviguer dans l’univers du crime et qui fera la rencontre de personnages hauts en couleur.

articles.t: Rockstar montre GTA 6 à la première personne : vous n'avez jamais rien vu d'aussi réaliste
articles.chapeau: Ce nouveau clip de GTA 6 ne ressemble presque pas à un jeu vidéo tellement il est photoréaliste.
articles.txt:
Ce nouveau clip de GTA 6 ne ressemble presque pas à un jeu vidéo tellement il est photoréaliste.
Il reste moins d’une semaine à patienter avant la sortie de GTA 6 . Le jeu de Rockstar Games sera enfin jouable sur PS5 et Xbox Series le 19 novembre prochain. Vous pouvez déjà lancer le préchargement de GTA 6 sur votre console si vous avez précommandé le jeu en version numérique ou en version physique (et que vous avez reçu la boîte contenant le code de téléchargement à temps).
Rockstar Games, connu pour sa communication laconique, met les bouchées doubles pour que GTA 6 ne quitte plus l’actualité avant la sortie. Le studio américain vient même de casser Internet avec un nouveau clip à la première personne au réalisme particulièrement impressionnant.
Le compte Instagram OnlyInDade a semé la zizanie en dévoilant une bluffante vidéo de GTA 6 à la première personne sur son compte Instagram. La séquence permet d’observer différentes voitures stationnées dans la rue depuis le siège passager d’un véhicule. Le personnage fait ensuite quelques pas dans la rue, toujours en observant de près les bolides. La qualité des textures de l’intérieur de la voiture et du trottoir est réellement impressionnante.
Le photoréalisme atteint un tel niveau que de nombreuses personnes se sont demandé s’il s’agissait d’une séquence de GTA 6 ou non. Rockstar Games a confirmé que c’était bien le cas en reposant la vidéo sur son propre compte Instagram . A priori, la vidéo serait tournée avec le smartphone accessible in-game. Sur le dernier plan pris depuis le trottoir, on aperçoit justement quelqu’un filmer ce qui correspond au début du clip depuis une voiture noire en train de rouler. Il ne s’agirait donc pas d’un mode à la première personne.
This is GTAVI, just confirmed by Rockstar on Instagram. https://t.co/S13tCKScNc
Rockstar Games est passé par les canaux de communication les plus surprenants pour la campagne de Grand Theft Auto 6 . La présentation dévoilée en exclusivité sur Netflix était déjà un choix singulier. Même chose pour les séquences de gameplay de GTA 6 incluses dans un épisode de South Park. Cette nouvelle séquence disponible uniquement sur Instagram s’ajoute à la liste. GTA 6 , qui dépasse déjà le milliard de revenus avant sa sortie , n’est définitivement pas un jeu comme les autres.
Le moment de la diffusion de cette vidéo sur Instagram n’est peut-être pas anodin. Les joueurs sortent tout juste de la déception d’apprendre que GTA 6 tournera seulement à 30 fps sur PS5 et PS5 Pro .

articles.t: GTA 6 players can still experience the game at 60fps, but it comes at a cost
articles.chapeau: It's possible, but some sacrifices need to be made
articles.txt:
GTA 6 players who just can't stand the idea of 30fps can apparently give their game a boost depending on your hardware.
GTA 6 is right around the corner, but it’s been hit by yet another controversy. Rockstar Games recently confirmed the game targets 30fps, even on high-end consoles like the PlayStation Pro.
While it probably won’t affect the game’s total sales, many gamers are appalled.
If they bought new hardware such as a PlayStation 5 Pro and a fancy new TV to go with it, we can understand why, but there’s already a potential fix floating around online.
Some argue that, depending on the TV you have, you’ll still be able to play the game at 30fps , but in a way that feels like 60fps. Here’s how.
This ‘hack’ comes from @jotmanjotman on X, who responded to DiscussingFilm’s post about GTA VI’s 30fps lock to share a “game changer” idea.
“Samsung TVs have a game motion plus setting that makes 30 fps games feel like 60. I used it for RDR2, and it was a game changer,” said jotmanjotman.
Most modern TVs have a Game Mode somewhere in their settings, but few have the Motion Plus setting that jotmanjotman describes. In the case of Samsung TVs, it’s only available on the high-end models like QLED and OLED.
After checking my own TV, I unfortunately don’t have that setting, so I’m unable to try it for myself, but whilst researching online, it does seem to make a difference. There’s a catch, though.
While gamers have reported the Motion Plus setting can make a 30fps game feel like it’s running at 60, it does cause some input delay.
For online multiplayer games this is absolutely a deal-breaker however jotmanjotman argues for a single-player RPG or story-driven game like Red Dead Redemption 2 or GTA VI that shouldn’t matter too much.
Personally, I’d rather have better inputs, but those who don’t care about a second delay, this might be your ticket to playing GTA VI at ‘60fps’.
With the game launching on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles, you’ve got time to try it with other capped 30fps games to see what you think.
READ NEXT: GTA 6's first player ratings surface early via PlayStation Store, oops
Since Rockstar dropped this bombshell, gamers around the world have cried out in protest, with some believing the game’s going to flop as a result.
It seems a bit dramatic given how no Rockstar game has ever targeted 60fps at launch, yet they’re some of the highest-selling games in history.
Personally, I think you only really notice the jump from 30fps to 60fps when you’ve played both versions of the game.
Switching between a game’s Quality and Performance mode makes you really see the difference, but since GTA VI will lack these different modes, everyone will have the same experience. There’ll be nothing to compare it to.
It’s also worth keeping in mind that Rockstar is a master when it comes to optimisation. While the world will be played at 30fps, it’s highly likely that it won’t dip below that target, and you’ll still get to soak up all of the in-game details at the same time.
Those who really can’t stand the idea of playing GTA VI at 30fps will just have to wait for the PC version, as even if Rockstar doesn’t boost the framerate, there’ll inevitably be some mods that do the trick.

GTA 6 sort le jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, mais il est déjà possible de repartir avec : les boîtes arrivent en magasin ce jeudi 12 novembre, deux jours après l’ouverture du préchargement. De quoi lancer le téléchargement de ses 212 Go dès ce soir , et être prêt à jouer à minuit le jour J. Même les joueurs restés sur Xbox One sont de la partie : Microsoft a confirmé que le jeu y sera jouable en streaming dès sa sortie .
Reste à ne pas le payer plus cher que nécessaire. Voici où trouver GTA 6 au meilleur prix, à une semaine de sa sortie.
Autre option qui peut valoir le coup, il suffit de revendre en même temps un jeu ou un accessoire de leur liste . En magasin, jusqu’au 30 novembre.
Mauvaise nouvelle pour les retardataires : en ligne, les bonnes affaires sur les précommandes se font rares. Pendant des mois, plusieurs enseignes, Leclerc, Amazon ou Auchan en tête, vendaient la boîte de GTA 6 autour de 60 €, soit une vingtaine d’euros sous le tarif officiel. À quelques jours de la sortie, ces offres sont épuisées en ligne, et le jeu s’affiche presque partout à son prix conseillé de 79,99 €. Pour le trouver à 60 €, il faudra se rendre en magasin (Intermarché, Auchan, Leclerc…).
En ligne, la meilleure option reste Cultura, qui le propose à 69,99 € avec un bon d’achat de 10 € (valable à partir du 30 novembre), et dispose encore de stock. Le jeu est livré en magasin dès le 17 novembre, ce qui laisse deux jours de battement pour le télécharger tranquillement avant la sortie.

articles.chapeau: Digital buyers get one month of GTA+, while physical boxes contain a download code rather than a disc.
articles.txt:
The wait for GTA 6 is almost over, and players can finally secure their copies ahead of its November 19 release.
Rockstar Games' highly anticipated open-world game is available to preorder for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with the Standard Edition costing $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition priced at $99.99.
You can get physical code-in-box copies from Amazon, Best Buy, GameStop, Target and Walmart. Digital versions are also available through the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store and Rockstar Games Store.
Here's what to know before choosing where and which edition to buy.
The Standard Edition costs $79.99, while the Ultimate Edition goes for $99.99. Physical code-in-box copies are available for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, although the Ultimate Edition is currently a digital-only purchase.
Available for PS5. Check the listing for current availability.
Check the available console versions and stock before ordering.
Available through Target's video game listings. Confirm the current price and platform before purchasing.
You can also purchase the digital versions directly from the PlayStation Store , Xbox Store and Rockstar Games Store .
Retailer prices and availability can change, so check the final listing before completing your purchase.
The $99.99 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition costs $20 more than the Standard Edition and comes with additional vehicles, weapons, customisation options and activities.
The extras are introduced throughout Jason and Lucia's story rather than being limited to a single collection of items.
One useful detail is that you don't necessarily have to decide on the Ultimate Edition before buying. Players who purchase the Standard Edition can later buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade through the PlayStation or Xbox storefronts.
That makes the $79.99 version a reasonable starting point if you're unsure whether the additional content is worth the extra $20.
Rockstar is offering the Vintage Vice City Pack to players who preorder or purchase GTA 6 before November 20, 2026.
There's also a digital preorder benefit, which is one free month of GTA+. The membership normally costs $7.99 per month and provides access to benefits in GTA Online and Rockstar's game library.
The distinction is worth noting. Both physical and digital purchases qualify for the Vintage Vice City Pack, but the additional GTA+ membership benefit is tied to digital purchases.
The biggest difference between the two versions is how you receive and access the game.
Digital copies are purchased directly through your console's storefront and can be downloaded ahead of launch. They also include the free month of GTA+ alongside the Vintage Vice City Pack.
Physical copies, on the other hand, come in a retail box containing a download code rather than a game disc. You'll still receive the Vintage Vice City Pack, but not the additional free GTA+ month.
This is an important distinction for collectors who prefer owning physical game discs. The GTA 6 retail box may look like a traditional game release, but it doesn't contain one.
For most players, the digital version is the more convenient option, especially if they want to preload the game and receive the additional GTA+ benefit. However, the physical code-in-box version is worth considering if you prefer buying from retailers or collecting the packaging.
GTA 6 is scheduled to launch on Thursday, November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Digital preloading began on November 10, allowing players who have already purchased the game to download it before launch. Physical code-in-box copies are expected to become available for shipping and pickup from November 12, with buyers able to redeem their codes and begin downloading the game.
Preloading means you won't have to wait for the full game download on launch day. However, the game remains locked until its official release.
Not at launch. Rockstar has confirmed PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the game's launch platforms, with no official PC release date announced.

articles.t: How to Avoid GTA 6 Spoilers: Words to Mute on Social Media Right Now
articles.chapeau: If you want to avoid GTA 6 spoilers, learn how to mute words on social media, including on X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, and more.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games has spent over a decade crafting the next massive chapter in the Grand Theft Auto franchise. Because the GTA 6 release date is right around the corner, navigating the internet safely without running into major GTA 6 spoilers requires a strong defensive strategy. One careless scroll could instantly ruin the story that you have patiently waited years to experience firsthand.
With 13 years since the last mainline Grand Theft Auto game, the global hype of GTA 6 reaches far beyond gaming communities. Casual social media users and content creators alike will soon flood every single timeline with late-game story footage. That is why, in this guide, we will help you mute all the words to avoid any GTA 6 spoilers on the internet.
Muting specific words and phrases across your favorite social media platforms is the best way to protect yourself. Because clever trolls often omit the game title from posts, you must block GTA 6 character names and general terms.
You should also include every possible title variation to ensure that your timeline filters catch all hidden leaks. GTA 6 RP mechanics are something you should keep as personal experience. So, it is better to avoid others’ playthroughs overall.
With that said, here is a list of all words you must use to avoid GTA 6 spoilers on the internet:
Now that you know which words to mute to keep your internet feed spoiler-free during the GTA 6 countdown , let us show you how you can do it on different platforms.
Setting up your social media filters before the release of GTA 6 guarantees that your feeds remain clean when leaks begin. On X, you can easily block specific phrases and hashtags from appearing in your timeline or notifications.
Follow these simple step-by-step instructions on desktop or mobile to set up your muted word list right now:
YouTube poses a threat to players because gamer or non-gaming content creators frequently put major plot reveals inside video thumbnails. Even though Rockstar Games issues copyright strikes against early leaks, new GTA 6 locations or characters videos will still slip through the cracks.
Desktop users should immediately install the BlockTube and Unhook browser extensions to hide recommended feeds and block channels. This will make sure you are not swarmed with channels you don’t want to see when GTA 6 drops.
If you watch YouTube on your phone or television, browser extensions cannot protect you from seeing recommendations. To stay safe on mobile devices, you should completely clear and pause your personal YouTube watch history immediately. Disabling your watch history disables the recommendation algorithm, leaving your home feed completely blank and safe from thumbnails.
You should also avoid searching for gameplay videos and stay away from comment sections under any gaming videos. We suggest you avoid typing the keywords from our list to avoid any kind of GTA 6 spoilers in the video search feed.
If a suspicious video appears, click the three dots icon and select the Not interested or Don’t recommend channel option immediately.
Moving the YouTube app on iPhone or Android to a hidden phone folder can also stop you from opening the app mindlessly.
The majority of the gamer or non-gamer audience spends time doomscrolling reels or liking the story of their crush on Instagram. This can cause a serious spoiler fest if you are not cautious when on Instagram during the GTA 6 launch.
Well, to prevent that, the first thing you must do is to completely make the algorithm unlearn your pattern of using the app. Start by marking posts containing GTA 6 spoilers as Not Interested. Tap the three dots on a post or Reel and select the option to see less similar content.
You can also mute or block accounts that frequently share GTA 6 leaks, gameplay clips, and story details. Avoid interacting with spoiler posts, even if you are only opening the comments. We suggest you avoid clicking any GTA 6-related content from the Discover feed. You should also mute stories of creators whom you know might share content about the game during the launch weeks.
Finally, use Instagram’s Hidden Words feature to filter keywords such as GTA 6, Lucia, Jason, and GTA VI. This can help keep spoiler-related posts and comments out of your feed while you wait for the game. articles.t: GTA 6 poses a threat to Hollywood: Streaming services and movie theaters fear losing viewers
articles.chapeau: The massive hype surrounding GTA 6 is expected to do more than just overshadow other video games. According to some analysts, the game could generate more revenue than Avengers: Doomsday and keep people away from movie theaters and streaming services for quite some time. Streaming platforms and movie theater operators are worried about losing their audiences. Could this gaming phenomenon become an industry-wide disruptor?
articles.txt:
Few entertainment products are generating as much buzz right now as GTA VI . The game is set to launch on November 19 for Xbox and PlayStation, and new updates about the title are emerging almost daily. Many other games have deliberately moved their release dates forward or pushed them back significantly to avoid competing with the new GTA.
But concerns about GTA 6's enormous potential success are no longer limited to the gaming industry. Hollywood, streaming platforms, and movie theater operators are also anticipating that Rockstar Games' open-world blockbuster will capture a significant share of consumers' attention and free time.
Geoff Keighley, host and producer of The Game Awards, has described GTA 6 as potentially the biggest entertainment launch in history. In his view, the game could even surpass box office blockbusters such as Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three in terms of revenue and reach.
According to Keighley, streaming services could be particularly hard hit by the game's success. Players are expected to spend more of their free time exploring GTA 6's fictional version of Florida rather than watching movies and TV shows on Netflix, HBO, Disney+, or other platforms. While a movie can be watched in two to three hours and then it's over, GTA 6 could hold consumers' attention for weeks or even months. That's thanks to its lengthy main storyline, an enormous world packed with activities, and an anticipated long-term online mode.
GTA 6 could therefore accelerate a shift that has been on Hollywood's radar for some time: video games are no longer just competing within the gaming industry. They're now going head-to-head with movies and streaming services for the audience's attention. However, it will take the coming months to determine whether these concerns actually translate into declining viewership.

articles.t: This game reportedly tops $1 billion before it even launches
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 has reportedly surpassed $1 billion in pre-orders ahead of launch, setting new records on both PlayStation and Xbox. Sensor Tower estimates that more than 10 million digital copies have already been ordered, while industry analysts expect the game to generate billions more in its first week.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has reportedly generated more than $1 billion in pre-orders ahead of its November 19 launch. Sony and Microsoft have also confirmed that the game is the most pre-ordered title in the history of both PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store, with Sony describing demand as "unprecedented."
According to Sensor Tower estimates, GTA 6 had attracted 10.31 million digital console pre-orders worth approximately $1 billion as of November 11. That's up from 7.71 million copies as of November 2.
ⓘ Sensor Tower Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 has reached $1 billion in pre-orders, with 10.31 million copies sold across PlayStation and Xbox. PlayStation accounts for the bulk of those orders, with an estimated 7.73 million copies worth $751 million. Xbox accounts for another 2.58 million copies and approximately $250 million in sales. The estimated average spending of around $97 per copy suggests that many buyers may be opting for the more expensive Ultimate Edition.
The figures have not been confirmed by Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive. However, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick recently said that pre-orders were running "far ahead" of the company's expectations. Meanwhile Sony described demand as “unprecedented,” while Microsoft also announced a preorder record for its store.
For comparison, Grand Theft Auto 5 generated more than $800 million in worldwide sales during its first 24 hours and passed $1 billion within three days of launch in September 2013. GTA 6 appears to be approaching a similar milestone before it even reaches players.
Industry forecasts suggest the launch of GTA 6 could generate substantially more. A July analysis by market research firm Newzoo projected cumulative global sales revenue of between $3.3 billion and $5.2 billion by the end of the first week after release.
GTA 6 pre-orders first opened on June 25. Players who pre-order the game by November 19 will also receive the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+. Sony and Microsoft are encouraging players to download the game ahead of launch to avoid delays on release day, and pre-loading began on November 10.
Microsoft has also announced that GTA 6 will be playable through Xbox Cloud Gaming, allowing Xbox One owners to access the game despite the lack of a native version for the older console generation.

articles.txt:
Il fallait s’y attendre, mais la machine semble tout de même s’être emballée ces derniers jours. D’après des chiffres compilés par le cabinet d’analyse Sensor Tower , GTA 6 aurait dépassé le milliard de dollars de vente le 11 novembre dernier et se serait déjà écoulé à plus de dix millions d’exemplaires. Un record alors que le jeu ne sortira officiellement que la semaine prochaine .
Ce faisant, il explose le précédent record également tenu par Rockstar, qui avait vu GTA 5 atteindre le milliard de dollars de recette trois jours après sa sortie. Et rien ne semble pouvoir arrêter le phénomène.

Malheureusement pour Microsoft d’ailleurs, la répartition des ventes du jeu semble toujours largement en faveur de Sony, si l’on en croit les chiffres de Sensor Tower. 75 % des unités vendues seraient des copies PlayStation. À cette vitesse, la version PlayStation pourrait à elle seule rapporter 1 milliard de dollars de revenu avant la sortie du jeu. À noter tout de même que l’arrivée du jeu sur Xbox One pourrait changer la tendance .
Il y a quelques jours à peine , le PDG de Take-Two, maison-mère de Rockstar, expliquait que les ventes de GTA 6 « dépassaient déjà largement » les prévisions établies par le studio. Et si l’on en croit l’historique de GTA 5 , qui a connu une nouvelle vague massive de vente la semaine de sa sortie, le mois de novembre 2026 devrait exploser tous les records.

articles.t: GTA 6 Targets 30 FPS on Consoles, With Ray-Traced Shadows Only on PS5 Pro
What's the cheapest way to play 'GTA 6' on launch day?
articles.chapeau: No, you do not need to drop $900 on a PS5 Pro.
articles.txt:
TL;DR: The cheapest way to play Grand Theft Auto VI natively on launch day is pairing the 512GB all-digital Xbox Series S ($499.99) with the standard digital edition of the game ($79.99), bringing your total day-one setup to $579.98.
Buying a brand-new console for a single video game is an expensive pill to swallow, but GTA 6 is forcing that choice. With Rockstar skipping PC at launch, anyone planning to cruise through Vice City on Nov. 19 will need dedicated console hardware.
If you look at the premium options, the price tag is intimidating. The PS5 Pro costs $899.99 before you even purchase software, which pushes a day-one setup past $979. Fortunately, you do not need to spend that kind of cash to be there at launch.
The cheapest way to play GTA 6 on day one is pairing the Xbox Series S with the standard digital edition of the game.
That puts you in Vice City for exactly $400 less than a PS5 Pro setup, and saves you anywhere from $100 to $250 compared to the other current-gen disc and digital consoles.
Opting for the lower-priced console does not mean you miss out on fluid gameplay compared to the rest of the market. Rockstar confirmed that GTA 6 targets 30 frames per second on every system, including base consoles and the PS5 Pro.
Sony's flagship hardware provides higher native resolution and enhanced ray-traced lighting, but it will not run the title at 60 fps at launch. On the Series S, you get lower resolution output and dialed-back graphical settings, but you experience the identical 30 fps gameplay, story missions, and open-world mechanics as every other player.
The biggest compromise with the entry-level Xbox is storage. The baseline Series S comes with a 512GB solid-state drive, which leaves around 364GB of usable space after the operating system takes its share.
With pre-loads confirming Grand Theft Auto VI requires a massive 212GB download, the game will take up over half of your internal drive on day one. You will likely need to clear out other big titles before installing it, but as long as you keep your drive free of excess clutter, you have plenty of room to pre-install and jump into Leonida when servers go live at 1 a.m. ET on launch day. Just be sure to preorder before Nov. 19. That locks in the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA+, while Xbox Smart Delivery guarantees your copy jumps to a Series X for free if you upgrade later.
If clearing out your other games to make room for that 212GB download feels like too much of a compromise, Microsoft also sells a 1TB Xbox Series S for $599.99 . Pairing that with the base game brings your total day-one spend to $679.98 — still $300 cheaper than a PS5 Pro, with double the onboard storage.
Rockstar also offers a $99.99 Ultimate Edition , but the extra $20 only buys cosmetic items and early vehicles — including the '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car, custom revolvers, and instant access to specialty vehicle and tattoo shops like Rideout Customs.
None of those bonus items affect the core campaign. If you preorder the standard edition before Nov. 19, you still receive the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+ included with the Ultimate edition.
If you still have an original Xbox One from 2013 hooked up to your TV , you don't technically need to buy new hardware. Rockstar and Microsoft confirmed the title will stream via Xbox Cloud Gaming on launch day, running on the Xbox Series S graphics profile .
That sounds like an easy budget win on paper, but it comes with some strings attached. You still have to purchase the standard digital game for $79.99 , since it is not included free with Game Pass. You are also subject to Microsoft's cloud playtime limits, which restrict streaming to 5 to 15 hours per month depending on your subscription tier, with additional blocks priced at $4 for every 10 hours.
Plus, Rockstar's cloud agreement blocks streaming to phones , tablets , and PCs entirely. If you own a Series S, though, standard local Remote Play still works, so you can stream your game locally from your console to a phone or tablet over your home WiFi without burning through cloud hours.
Between choppy streams, lag, and launch-night traffic, relying on the cloud is a gamble for a game this big. If you want a smooth, headache-free experience on day 1 without dropping nearly four figures, the $499.99 Series S and the $79.99 base game give you the smartest route into Vice Ci

articles.t: Best console deals for GTA 6: Where to find PS5 and Xbox stock ahead of launch day
articles.chapeau: Spoiler alert: You are going to end up paying full retail price.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 finally launches on Nov. 19, and if you still need hardware to play, here's the truth: none of the consoles are actually on sale. Between massive launch hype and tight hardware supply, Sony and Microsoft are holding firm at standard retail prices across the board, so your best move right now is simply finding a legitimate system in stock before shelves clear out.
With launch day right around the corner, inventory is already drying up — especially on higher-end models like the PS5 Pro, which is largely sold out at major stores. Because there is no PC version at launch and older systems like the PS4 and Xbox One cannot run the game natively, everyone is scrambling for the handful of current-gen PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S models that are still in stock.
To save you from wading through third-party marketplace listings charging hundreds of dollars above sticker price, we rounded up the consoles that can play GTA 6 on day one — and where you still have a solid shot at grabbing them at regular retail price before they vanish.
If you want to play Grand Theft Auto VI on day one without spending a small fortune, the Xbox Series S is the cheapest brand-new ticket into Vice City. Because it is an all-digital console with no disc drive, you will need to download the game directly from the Xbox Store. Even with simpler graphics settings and a lower screen resolution than the flagship consoles, it still runs the game at the exact same 30 fps as the PS5 Pro and supports quick game-switching, while keeping plenty of cash in your bank account. If you want a PlayStation without paying extra for a disc drive, the PlayStation 5 Slim Digital Edition is Sony's lowest-priced current-gen console. Because it is a digital-only system, you will need to download Grand Theft Auto VI directly from the PlayStation Store, though its 825GB hard drive gives you plenty of room out of the box. You still get the exact same power and DualSense controller features — including haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D audio — as the disc version, and you can always buy Sony's external disc drive add-on separately later if you change your mind.
If you prefer buying physical game discs instead of relying solely on downloads, the standard PlayStation 5 Console is the only current-gen PS5 model with a built-in Blu-ray drive out of the box. Having a disc drive lets you pick up a physical copy of Grand Theft Auto VI at a local store, lend it to a friend once you roll credits, or trade it in later. It also bumps the built-in solid-state drive up to a full 1TB, giving you plenty of storage space, along with the same DualSense controller features, fast load times, and the pre-installed Astro's Playroom game as in the Digital Edition.
If you want sharper 4K visuals and a built-in disc drive on the Xbox side, the Microsoft Xbox Series X Console is the best model to grab. Unlike the cheaper Series S, it comes with a full 1TB of storage space out of the box, plays physical game discs, and makes Vice City look noticeably sharper while running at the same 30 fps speed as every other console. Outside of Grand Theft Auto VI , features like Quick Resume let you hop back into different games without waiting on loading screens, and it plays older games from four generations of Xbox — including classics like Red Dead Redemption 2 , Grand Theft Auto IV , and Halo 3 .
If you want the sharpest picture and best lighting possible when exploring Vice City, the PlayStation 5 Pro Console is the system to buy. Even though Grand Theft Auto VI still runs at 30 fps on the Pro just like every other console, Rockstar confirmed it gets exclusive ray-traced shadows and cleaner image upscaling that you will not find anywhere else. It also comes with a massive 2TB solid-state drive that easily swallows the huge game file, leaving plenty of room, though keep in mind it ships without a disc drive — so you will need to download the game digitally or buy Sony's detachable disc drive separately.
Console discounts might be off the table right now, so your best move is to lock down your system at regular retail price before Vice City traffic clears the rest of the shelves.

articles.chapeau: Vote de popularité.
articles.txt: Le dernier trailer de GTA 6 amène de nombreuses personnes à se demander si un personnage emblématique d’un précédent opus de la franchise fait son retour. Dans la dernière bande-annonce de GTA 6 , publiée hier pour annoncer les préchargements , on aperçoit un personnage vêtu d’un débardeur bleu et portant d’épaisses lunettes noires qui déclare : « Oh, ça va vraiment chauffer maintenant. » Il semble que ce soit la première fois que l’on aperçoive ce personnage mystérieux dans GTA 6, et il y a peut-être une raison à cela. Certains fans pensent qu’il s’agit d’un Tony Prince (alias Gay Tony) plus âgé et légèrement plus rond. Ce personnage a fait ses débuts dans GTA 4 et est apparu dans les deux DLC, mais il était au centre de l’extension The Ballad of Gay Tony. Dans cette histoire, les joueurs incarnaient Luis, le bras droit de Tony. Tony Prince était un propriétaire de boîte de nuit très en vue à Liberty City, mais il a depuis connu des hauts et des bas.

articles.t: GTA 6 preorders top $1 billion as Hollywood eyes launch weekend
articles.chapeau: Sony and Microsoft say it's already the most preordered game in the history of their digital stores.
articles.txt:
It's been 13 years since Rockstar dropped a new mainline Grand Theft Auto , so there was always going to be a fairly large crowd for the next one. A week before launch, we're getting a sense of just how big that crowd is.
Eight days before its Nov. 19 release, GTA 6 has already topped $1 billion in preorders, according to an estimate from market research firm Sensor Tower . The firm also estimates that players worldwide have preordered more than 10 million digital copies for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S . (About three out of every four orders were for PS5, The Washington Post reported on Nov. 11.) The previous game, GTA V , hit that same $1 billion milestone three days after it went on sale in 2013, according to publisher Take-Two Interactive .
Take-Two has yet to share its own preorder tally for the sequel, though CEO Strauss Zelnick wrote in a release on Monday that orders were reaching "unprecedented levels. " Both Sony and Microsoft also said it's already the most preordered game in the history of their respective digital stores.
Rockstar opened preloads on Nov. 10 , so players can get the download out of the way before launch day.
The hype for GTA 6 has been building for nearly three years, ever since Rockstar released its first trailer in December 2023 . It drew more than 90 million YouTube views in 24 hours, setting a Guinness World Record , and has 302 million views as of Nov. 11, 2026.
Rockstar gave fans more than trailers to watch while they waited. In August, it premiered Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look , a 27-minute preview made entirely from in-game footage, on Netflix before putting it on YouTube later that day. The rollout spilled into music, too. The official album drops alongside the game on Nov. 19, and two days later, Rockstar and PlayStation will host a music festival in Miami with performances from Cardi B, Travis Scott, and Justice, who composed the game’s score. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile
Streamers have made their own entertainment out of the countdown. IShowSpeed reacted to the launch trailer on YouTube , amassing 1.7 million views, while Twitch streamer Kai Cenat has gone back through the series, spending more than 130 hours playing five older GTA games.
The anticipation has reached a level where Hollywood's ears have perked up. When Screen Engine and The Wrap asked people which upcoming movie, show, or game they were most excited about, GTA 6 came out on top for the sixth week in a row , drawing 8.3 percent of mentions in the latest survey, ahead of Avengers: Doomsday at 6.7 percent.
That's unfortunate data to see as an entertainment exec, especially considering The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens the next day, when new seasons of Yellowjackets and Percy Jackson and the Olympians also premiere. All three are arriving on a weekend when some fans have already taken time off to spend in Vice City. "Hollywood should look at the hours as closely as the dollars," The Game Awards founder Geoff Keighley told The Hollywood Reporter .
When I say time off, by the way, I mean literally. Some fans have already blocked off those hours on their work calendars. As Mashable's Amanda Yeo noted in September , a Thursday release means two vacation days can buy a four-day weekend playing the game, though some were already talking about taking a week or more . HR software company BambooHR found that employees requested Nov. 19 off at a rate 13 percent higher than for comparable days in 2024 and 2025. In a separate survey, 18 percent of salaried workers said they planned to take launch day off to play.
As for workplaces, the company Logitech is giving employees a day off to play a game of their choice, and its gaming division will stream from its San Jose headquarters on launch day . Even an Army unit at Fort Stewart in Georgia allegedly offered eligible soldiers a four-day pass timed to the release if they reenlisted by Nov. 14.
By the time Avengers: Doomsday opens in December, those launch-day vacation days will be long gone. The question for Hollywood is how many people will still want to spend their precious free time in Vice City versus watching TV or going to the movies. If preorders are any indication, quite a few.

articles.t: GTA 6 dépasse Fortnite et la Ligue des champions - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: Le préchargement de GTA 6 a battu deux records chez Virgin Media O2. Voici le bilan de l’opérateur britannique
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre prochain. Son préchargement a battu deux records chez Virgin Media O2. L’opérateur britannique indique avoir enregistré son plus gros pic de trafic et son plus grand volume de données sur une journée.
Ces chiffres concernent son réseau fixe au Royaume-Uni, au moment où les joueurs ayant précommandé le titre ont eu le feu vert pour débuter le téléchargement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.
Comme nous l’avons indiqué le premier record concerne le pic de trafic. Il a dépassé de 3,8 % celui enregistré pendant la demi-finale de Ligue des champions entre Arsenal et l’Atlético de Madrid.
Ensuite sur l’ensemble de la journée du 10 novembre, le volume de données a dépassé de 4 % le précédent record, établi lors du lancement d’une mini-saison de Fortnite le 1er novembre.
L’effet a été là dès l’ouverture du préchargement. Entre minuit et 1 h du matin, le trafic a explosé de 51,6 % par rapport au même créneau une semaine plus tôt. À 9 h, le volume cumulé dépassait dejà de 73,3 % celui du mardi précédent à la même heure. Ces chiffres couvrent l’ensemble des usages sur le réseau de l’opérateur.
Sur PS5, Sony annonce 212 Go d’espace libre pour le téléchargement de GTA VI. Pour un transfert de 200 Go, comptez théoriquement 4 h 27 à 100 Mbit/s, contre 27 minutes à 1 Gbit/s.
Le temps réel va donc dépendre du débit de la ligne, des possibilités de la console et des autres usages associé à la connexion. C’est justement pour cela qu’un préchargement a été autorisé à partir du 10 novembre. L’idée est de garantir un certain temps face à un tel volume de données.
Rockstar indique que le jeu sera débloqué le 19 novembre à minuit, heure locale, sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.

articles.t: GTA VI : le jeu aurait déjà généré plus d’un milliard de dollars avant sa sortie
GTA 6 gamers spot first Xbox 'downgrade' as launch day looms
articles.chapeau: This is taking "plays best" too far 😅
articles.txt:
Copies of GTA 6 are beginning to arrive, with one difference spotted between the Xbox and PlayStation versions.
Grand Theft Auto VI ’s November 19 launch is almost finally upon us, with copies of the game already in the hands of many.
Preloads for digital copies of the game began on November 10 after Rockstar Games shifted the date forwards due to the title’s enormous file size .
For those who opted for code-in-a-box copies, preloads open today, on November 12.
Those who have a code-in-a-box copy in hand have taken to social media to reveal that the box features a double-sided fold-up poster, which is a nice touch.
One side features Lucia, with GTA VI ’s key art appearing on the other; the Grand Theft Auto franchise’s classic art style is used.
What has now been realised, however, is that those with an Xbox code-in-a-box copy are getting a slight downgrade compared to their PlayStation counterparts.
X (formerly Twitter) user GameRiot took to the site to share that “the GTA VI poster is actually smaller on Xbox compared to PS5”.
You can see in the video clip below that we’re not talking a couple of milimetres here.
There is likely a very good reason for this, as GameRiot points out, and that’s all down to case sizing.
While PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S physical cases are similarly sized, it appears that the area for posters, booklets, and such like within the Xbox case is slightly smaller.
Therefore, GTA VI ’s poster has been made smaller to fit accordingly, rather than this being any form of intentional slight to Xbox users.
It may feel that way amid Rockstar Games and PlayStation’s ongoing “plays best” marketing campaign that favours Sony’s console.
What isn’t abundantly clear yet is whether this difference in poster sizing is worldwide or whether this is unique to where GameRiot is based in the UK.
Grand Theft Auto fans are definitely seeing the humour in this latest spot.
“They taking plays best on PS5 too seriously,” added vce_bby.
It’s a shame that Jason doesn’t get the chance to shine on the poster, unless he’s going to pop up elsewhere.
GameRiot did confirm that the PS5’s poster is roughly A3 sized while Xbox’s is understandably somewhat below A3 which could make the Xbox version difficult to frame, if that’s something you’re interested in.
READ MORE: GTA 6's first player ratings surface early via PlayStation Store, oops
It’s definitely been a busy week for GTA VI with an endless stream of marketing continuing to rollout.
Rockstar Games announced GTA VI : The Festival , a once-in-a-lifetime launch party based in Miami, Florida, plus Metacritic and Fandom have revealed a contest where you could win up to $500 in Visa gift cards simply by predicting GTA VI ’s Metacritic score .
We’ve also had confirmation that GTA VI will only run at 30fps , including on the PlayStation 5 Pro - something that’s ruffled a few feathers.
If you haven’t preloaded your game already, you may want to this weekend. GTA VI will be here before you know it.

Rockstar Games les annonçait chez les revendeurs à partir de ce jeudi 12 novembre, et Micromania affiche bien « sortie le 12 nov. », avec un jeu à 39,99 € si vous revendez un jeu éligible. Chez E.Leclerc, en revanche, les fiches du jeu à 60 € indiquent ce matin « Disponible en magasin à partir du 19/11/26 ». Voici ce que nous avons relevé enseigne par enseigne, et comment éviter de vous déplacer pour rien.
Sur sa fiche GTA VI pour PS5 , Micromania annonce une « prochaine sortie 12 nov. 2026 (jouable le 19 nov. 2026) ». Le jeu est à 79,99 € sur PS5 comme sur Xbox Series X, mais l’enseigne met surtout en avant son offre « Jouez à » :
Avec la reprise, GTA 6 tombe à 39,99 €, soit la moitié du prix affiché.
Attention au mode de retrait. Le retrait en magasin en 1 h est gratuit, mais ce matin, la livraison en point relais était estimée au jeudi 19 novembre , le jour de la sortie. Si vous voulez précharger, la boutique reste donc la meilleure option. Pour les PS5 trop pleines, le pack jeu et SSD de 1 To reste à 279,99 €, avec une livraison en magasin estimée au 17 novembre.
Les deux manettes DualSense en édition limitée Grand Theft Auto VI, à 84,99 €. © Sony Interactive Entertainment Leclerc : 60 €, mais deux dates sur le même site C’est le point qui risque de faire des déçus. Sur la page d’aide E.Leclerc , l’enseigne écrit toujours que le jeu à 60 € au lieu de 79,99 € sera « disponible directement en magasin à partir du 12 novembre 2026 », avec le pack Vintage Vice City offert. Mais ce jeudi matin, les fiches produits PS5 et Xbox Series affichent « Précommande épuisée. Disponible en magasin à partir du 19/11/26 ». La description de ces mêmes fiches promet, elle, une réception « à partir du 12 novembre ».
Notre conseil : appelez votre magasin E.Leclerc ou votre Espace Culturel avant de vous déplacer, et demandez si les boîtes sont déjà en rayon.
Même mention chez Leclerc pour la manette DualSense édition limitée Grand Theft Auto VI blanche : 84,90 €, précommande épuisée, en magasin à partir du 19 novembre. Sur le PlayStation Store , les versions blanche et noire étaient encore en précommande ce matin, à 84,99 €, pour une sortie le 19 novembre. Sony annonce ces manettes en quantités limitées.
Sur la fiche GTA 6 d’Auchan , le jeu est « pré-téléchargeable à partir du 12/11/2026 », et le bon de réduction de 10 € tient toujours : envoyé à partir du 24 novembre, valable jusqu’au 30 novembre dès 50 € d’achat. Le prix s’affiche désormais après le choix d’un magasin. La boîte PS5 est aussi référencée chez Cultura .
Vice City, sur le front de mer, dans Grand Theft Auto VI. © Rockstar Games Ce qu’il faut savoir avant d’ouvrir la boîte Aucun disque : la boîte contient un code de téléchargement, utilisable une seule fois, sur un compte du bon pays. Préchargement : Rockstar indique que les acheteurs de la boîte peuvent activer leur code et précharger « dès réception ». Prévoyez jusqu’à 212 Go . Édition Ultime : elle n’existe pas en boîte. Micromania précise que vous pourrez passer à l’Édition Ultime sur le PlayStation Store une fois le code de l’Édition Standard utilisé. Sortie : jeudi 19 novembre, à minuit heure locale sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Source : Rockstar Games, Micromania, PlayStation
Si vous avez raté nos précédents épisodes, nous avons détaillé le préchargement de 212 Go et le record de précommandes et l’arrivée sur Xbox One .
Si vous avez un jeu de la liste qui dort sur une étagère, l’offre Micromania est la plus intéressante ce jeudi : 39,99 € et une boîte disponible en magasin dès aujourd’hui, selon l’enseigne. Le prix de 60 € chez Leclerc reste séduisant sans rien revendre, mais la date du 19 novembre affichée sur ses fiches change tout si vous comptiez jouer dès minuit : sans préchargement, il faudra télécharger plus de 200 Go le soir de la sortie.
Le jour de la boîte n’est pas le même partout : vérifiez la date avant de prendre la voiture.

Take-Two reportedly targets GTA 6 Mapping Project, closing Discord that shared leaks
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 Mapping Project charted Leonida long before Rockstar revealed more about the open-world. A week ahead of the release date, Take-Two may have finally pursued a DMCA takedown of the resource. Its Discord server vanished without warning, leaving the project's status in doubt.
articles.txt:
For the past four years, the GTA 6 Mapping Project has constructed a Leonida based on screenshots , trailers , and leaks . Unfortunately, the community initiative is in danger after its Discord server suddenly disappeared. While the reason is unclear, followers suspect Take-Two requested a DMCA takedown as the game’s release date approaches.
On November 11th, chatters reported they could no longer access the server. The existing invitation link to join discussions is a dead end. Despite mods removing content that could infringe on copyrights, questionable material may have spread regardless.
Take-Two and Rockstar have a history of pursuing channels that promote leaks. Most of the activity stemmed from Cyberleek posting gameplay clips from a pre-release build . The individual also uploaded an in-game GTA 6 map , which the mapping project combined with its own discoveries. In August, Take-Two issued subpoenas to Discord and Microsoft to trace the hacker’s whereabouts.
The good news is that, for now, the State of Leonida website remains available. As preloads continue , visitors can examine the open world, including Vice City and surrounding areas . Clicking markers reveals information about destinations and how they compare to real-world locales. Nevertheless, Discord has been essential in developing the navigational aid.
Before each version of the user-created GTA 6 map is published, members share findings from screenshots and trailers. The team effort has uncovered overlooked details in Rockstar’s official media and unauthorized leaks.
With the GTA 6 release date nearly here, fans may think the mapping project is losing its appeal. However, GTA Wiki plans to keep the resource relevant following the game’s launch. After announcing it had become a co-owner in late October, the focus will shift to identifying Florida landmarks . It could also guide players by charting the position of Leonida’s hidden destinations and easter eggs.
Hopefully, the community can find an alternative to Discord for collaboration. Still, Take-Two seems intent on pursuing copyright strikes that prevent last-minute geographic spoilers .

articles.t: GTA 6 : un DLC officiel gratuit révélé par une fuite pour le plus grand plaisir des joueurs
articles.chapeau: À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
articles.txt:
À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
GTA 6 n’est même pas encore sorti et un premier « DLC » gratuit fait déjà parler de lui. Une fuite du code de Discord mentionne une campagne marketing baptisée « Hexagon » , centrée sur Grand Theft Auto VI , avec thème dédié et récompense mystérieuse à la clé.
Derrière ce nom de code se cacherait ce que certains médias décrivent déjà comme un premier GTA 6 DLC gratuit . Entre contenu cosmétique, éventuelle récompense in‑game et bonus de pré‑lancement, la communauté s’interroge sur ce que cette collaboration pourrait réellement offrir.
Le dataminer Wumpus Central a fouillé une version de test de Discord et repéré une campagne GTA 6 Discord nommée « Hexagon ». Dans les fichiers figurent une icône d’application GTA 6 , un app theme aux couleurs de Vice City et une police de pseudo inspirée de la typo officielle du jeu. Des sites comme RockstarINTEL ou GTA BOOM ont rapidement relayé l’information.
Plus intéressant pour les joueurs, le code mentionne une « quest with unknown reward » qui « may be coming soon during the campaign too », selon Wumpus Central sur X. GamingBible parle déjà de « first free in‑game reward » pour GTA 6 , d’où l’expression de contenu additionnel GTA 6 ou de « DLC gratuit ». Mais rien ne prouve encore que la récompense sera utilisable dans le jeu plutôt que limitée à Discord.
Les Discord Quest sont des campagnes où l’utilisateur doit accomplir une action pour décrocher une récompense : jouer à un jeu un certain temps, regarder un trailer ou participer à un événement. En 2022, par exemple, des quêtes liées à Fortnite Paradise permettaient de débloquer des objets in‑game, tandis que d’autres campagnes n’offraient que des cosmétiques Discord comme des décorations d’avatar.
Pour cette quête Discord GTA 6 , plusieurs scénarios sont plausibles : simple bonus Discord (thème exclusif, décorations de profil), skin d’arme ou tenue unique dans GTA 6 , voire petit avantage de pré‑commande lié au compte Rockstar Social Club. Dans tous les cas, il faudra très probablement accepter la Quest dans l’interface officielle, puis remplir l’objectif indiqué. Attention aux faux liens « GTA 6 Discord Hexagon » envoyés en message privé, terrain idéal pour le phishing .
D’après le datamine relayé par RockstarINTEL , la campagne Hexagon débuterait le 17 novembre 2026 à 18 h 00 UTC, soit 19 h en France, deux jours avant la sortie officielle de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Les utilisateurs gratuits pourraient participer jusqu’au 8 décembre 2026, tandis que les abonnés Discord Nitro auraient jusqu’au 15 février 2027.
Ce possible bonus GTA 6 avant la sortie s’inscrirait dans une stratégie où Rockstar Games mise sur des collaborations et des freebies plutôt que sur des DLC solo payants dès le lancement. Officiellement, ni Rockstar ni Discord n’ont confirmé la campagne Hexagon, qui pourrait encore être modifiée ou annulée. Les joueurs en quête de GTA 6 DLC gratuit ont donc tout intérêt à surveiller les annonces officielles et l’onglet Quest de Discord à l’approche du 17 novembre.

articles.t: GTA 6 pourrait finalement proposer un mode 40 FPS sur PS5 Pro grâce au 120 Hz et à un PSSR amélioré
articles.chapeau: À quelques jours du lancement de GTA 6, une datamine du préchargement PS5 Pro révèle un mode 120 Hz et un PSSR 13.60 inédit. Faut-il y voir le signe d’un futur mode 40 FPS très convoité ?
articles.txt:
À quelques jours du lancement de GTA 6, une datamine du préchargement PS5 Pro révèle un mode 120 Hz et un PSSR 13.60 inédit. Faut-il y voir le signe d’un futur mode 40 FPS très convoité ?
À quelques jours de la sortie console de Grand Theft Auto VI , fixée au 19 novembre 2026, un détail enfoui dans le préchargement PS5 agite la communauté. En fouillant ces fichiers mis en ligne dès le 10 novembre, le dataminer Tex2 , figure de GTAForums , a repéré un mode 120 Hz dédié à la PS5 Pro et une nouvelle version de la technologie d’upscaling PSSR de Sony .
Relayée par RockstarINTEL et la presse spécialisée, la fuite mentionne un module « MFSR / PSSR 13.60 » ainsi qu’une absence totale de tag VRR . Ce combo 120 Hz sans VRR correspond parfaitement à un mode 40 FPS , même si, officiellement, Rockstar ne promet toujours que 30 FPS sur consoles, avec un rendu interne probablement autour de 1440p upscalé en 4K. De quoi espérer une GTA 6 plus fluide sur PS5 Pro, sans aucune garantie pour l’instant.
Une datamine ne pirate pas le jeu, elle lit simplement les capacités que le moteur déclare à la console. Dans le build PS5 Pro de GTA 6 , Tex2 a repéré un flag « High Frame Rate 120 Hz » et un « High CPU Frequency Mode », ce qui confirme un profil distinct de la PS5. On y voit aussi un bloc PSSR en version 13.60, alors que de nombreux titres « PS5 Pro Enhanced » restent sur la branche 13.00A, et la build PS5 standard ne mentionne pas QSSR , l’upscaler des consoles non Pro.
Sur un téléviseur 120 Hz, un mode 40 FPS s’intègre bien, car 120 divisé par 40 donne trois rafraîchissements par image, avec un temps d’affichage moindre qu’à 30 FPS. Associé au PSSR 13.60, conçu pour approcher la 4K tout en calculant moins de pixels en interne, ce profil donne à la PS5 Pro un terrain pour viser un framerate plus élevé. Mais, comme l’a rappelé Rob Nelson , co-directeur de Rockstar North , cité par Notebookcheck, les développeurs « visent les 30 fps pour la date de sortie du 19 novembre », un monde ouvert comme Leonida restant très gourmand en processeur.
Passer de 30 à 40 FPS représenterait environ 33 % d’images en plus, une latence un peu plus faible et des mouvements plus naturels, à condition de disposer d’une TV 120 Hz HDMI 2.1 et d’activer le 120 Hz dans les réglages système de la console. Mais les métadonnées ne prouvent que ce que le moteur peut faire, pas ce que Rockstar Games exposera dans les options, et avec une PS5 Pro vendue autour de 899,99 € en France, beaucoup attendront la présentation officielle des modes graphiques et les premiers tests avant de décider si un 40 FPS justifie l’investissement.

articles.t: Bethesda denies The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel leak of news on Skyrim anniversary
articles.chapeau: Bethesda dismissed any chance of the Skyrim 15th Anniversary involving its sequel. On Reddit, the company poured cold water on rumors of a November 11th update. The studio recently asked gamers anxious for an Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date to be patient.
articles.txt:
Todd Howard finally announced the full name of the most anticipated Bethesda game. The studio head also cautioned fans not to expect more news soon, casting doubt on The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date . Still, rumors emerged teasing that the Skyrim 15th Anniversary could bring a surprise. Sadly, the publisher has now dismissed the possibility with a Reddit post .
Bethesda surprised readers by joining an Elder Scrolls 6 discussion focused on the Skyrim celebration. Its official account confirmed there would be no “big announcements” on November 11th. The company then stated it will “not be sharing anything new on Sentinel for some time.”
The comments match what the studio said after the November 3rd Bethesda 40th birthday update . Followers did gain a clue from the subtitle and video, which hinted at the game taking place in Hammerfell. Otherwise, none of the revelations suggested an Elder Scrolls 6 release date in the near future.
Despite evidence to the contrary, hopes were raised again ahead of Skyrim’s 15th Anniversary. Content creator King Fan Man is partly responsible, claiming a studio source told him of imminent news. Reece “Kiwi Talkz” Reilly then made a vaguer statement about a November 11th development. Even so, it was not necessarily related to the open-world RPG .
Waiting since 2011 for a sequel, desperate fans look for any reason to be optimistic. Xbox would also like to see progress with its popular franchises to boost sinking profits. The reality is that an Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date in 2027 or even 2028 has become unlikely.
Bloomberg insider Jason Schreier recently warned the Bethesda game wouldn’t surface for more than two years. He said he learned of a development timetable making 2029 a realistic target. Windows Central’s Jez Corden echoed that thinking in his own report.

articles.t: GTA 6: The iconic Grotti Cheetah became a reality
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs have created a real-life Grotti Cheetah inspired by GTA 6.
articles.txt:
One of the most recognizable cars in the Grand Theft Auto is leaving the digital streets and entering the real world, thanks to an impressive collaboration between Rockstar Games and car builder and conversion company West Coast Customs . The two companies have created a real-life Grotti Cheetah , inspired by the iconic supercar from the GTA series, which is now available to anyone with the necessary amount: 1 million pounds.
The unique vehicle is being showcased at Selfridges in London as part of a special promotion for the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI . The initiative aims to bring elements from the game's fantasy world into everyday life, giving fans of the series the opportunity to interact with objects and experiences that have previously only existed on their screens.
The Grotti Cheetah is one of the signature vehicles of the Grand Theft Auto world, having become associated with the luxury, high performance and distinctive aesthetics of the supercars that players encounter in the series' virtual cities.
The real-life version was created by West Coast Customs, known for its impressive custom builds and luxury vehicle conversions. The result retains the design identity that references the digital model, while adopting a very distinctive look, with bold pink and blue hues .
The color choice is not accidental. It directly refers to the aesthetics of Vice City , the fictional city that is the main setting of GTA 6 and draws inspiration from Miami. These specific colors have become an integral element of the new game's visual identity, connecting the 1980s with modern Florida culture.
The real Grotti Cheetah is priced at an impressive £1 million, placing it in the category of extremely expensive collector cars. This is a build that appeals not only to luxury vehicle collectors, but also to people who have a special connection to the Rockstar franchise.
The car launch is part of a wider partnership between Rockstar Games and British department store Selfridges. From November 9th to 28th, visitors to the London store can discover a specially curated experience dedicated to the world of Grand Theft Auto VI .
In addition to the impressive car, the installation features official merchandise and collectibles inspired by the game's locations, businesses and culture. Available options include Vice City sports team uniforms , as well as t-shirts, aprons and hats featuring the logo of Burger Shot , the fictional fast food chain that is a familiar fixture in the GTA universe.
The collection also extends to jackets, bags and various accessories with references to Leonida , the state in which the story of GTA 6 takes place. In this way, Rockstar is not limited to presenting an impressive car, but is creating a complete commercial experience around the new game .
See also: GTA VI will require up to 212GB of hard drive space to download
This collaboration highlights how major video game franchises are now attempting to expand their presence beyond traditional entertainment platforms . Games are not just digital products, but have evolved into cultural brands with their own fashion, music, aesthetics and consumer audience .
For Rockstar Games, such actions are a way to maintain interest around GTA 6, while also reaching an audience that might be interested in fashion, collectibles, or the automotive industry. Leveraging recognizable elements, such as the Grotti Cheetah and Burger Shot, creates a bridge between the game experience and the real world.
At the same time, the limited duration of the exhibition and the particularly high price of the car reinforce the collectible nature of the initiative. The Grotti Cheetah is not just another promotional vehicle, but an object aimed at an audience with a keen interest in the history and identity of the series.
The promotion is taking place ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, which is scheduled for November 19. Expectations around the new title are particularly high, as it is Rockstar's next major release after years of waiting and continued interest from the global gaming community.

articles.t: Rockstar reveals GTA 6 console performance targets and PS5 Pro upgrades
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will target 30 FPS across the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles, including the PS5 Pro. Sony's upgraded console will instead receive exclusive ray-traced shadows and PSSR upscaling, while a 60 FPS performance mode remains unconfirmed.
articles.txt:
With Grand Theft Auto VI preloads now underway, Rockstar Games has finally shed more light on how its highly anticipated open-world title will perform on current-generation consoles. As many had suspected, the game will target 30 FPS across the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S lineup, including Sony's more powerful PlayStation 5 Pro.
According to Rockstar's official announcement , the 30 FPS target was chosen to maintain the density and visual fidelity of Leonida's expansive open world. This effectively puts an end to speculation about the PS5 Pro delivering a substantially higher frame rate at launch, although Rockstar has not explicitly ruled out additional graphics modes.
Instead, the PS5 Pro will distinguish itself through improved image quality. Rockstar has confirmed support for PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), Sony's AI-powered upscaling technology, alongside ray-traced shadows exclusive to the upgraded console.
Interestingly, recent datamining findings suggest that GTA VI could use a newer implementation of PSSR than existing PS5 Pro titles. References to version 13.60 were discovered in the preload metadata, compared with version 13.00A reportedly used by games such as Cyberpunk 2077 and Assassin's Creed Shadows .
Another interesting discovery is a reference to 120 Hz output . This has fueled speculation about a possible 40 FPS mode in GTA 6 , which would provide a middle ground between 30 FPS and 60 FPS on compatible displays. A 40 FPS presentation can fit evenly into a 120 Hz refresh cycle, making it a viable alternative for graphically demanding games. However, the presence of a 120 Hz option does not confirm that Rockstar intends to offer it.
The preload metadata also reportedly lacks references to QSSR , Sony's newer upscaling solution for the standard PS5. That does not conclusively rule out its inclusion in the final game, but it suggests that the base console may not receive the same upscaling improvements as its Pro counterpart.
Beyond graphical enhancements, Rockstar has confirmed that the PlayStation 5 version will support DualSense haptic feedback, improved spatial audio through Tempest 3D Audio and optimised loading times. The developer has not detailed equivalent platform-specific enhancements for the Xbox Series X or Series S. Not that there are too many to begin with, except Quick Resume, maybe.
It is worth noting that the 30 FPS target does not necessarily guarantee a locked frame rate under all circumstances. Similarly, Rockstar has not disclosed the rendering resolutions or graphical compromises required for the Xbox Series S, which has considerably less GPU power and available memory than the Series X.
GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloads are already available, with Rockstar confirming that players will need up to 212 GB of available storage, depending on their console.

articles.t: GTA 6 Trophies: Rumoured List of All 55
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 trophies may have leaked, with a rumoured list of 55 achievements going viral. Here’s the full list and why to be cautious.
articles.txt:
A list claiming to show every one of the GTA 6 trophies has started spreading online. According to the posts, Rockstar’s game will feature 55 trophies and achievements, including a platinum. However, the list hasn’t been confirmed, and many fans think it’s fake.
With launch just days away, here’s the full rumoured list, along with the reasons to be cautious.
The rumour claims there are 55 in total, covering the story, side activities, collectibles and completion. The 55-trophy figure first appeared on social media on November 8. A full list then followed soon after.
That said, the reports don’t fully line up. One earlier version described 54 achievements plus a final one, while the newer list simply numbers them from 1 to 55.
Be warned: if the list is real, some entries could hint at story events. Here’s everything it claims:
14. Florida Man: Complete 10 random world events 15. Gator Got Your Tongue: Survive an alligator attack 16. Swamp Thing: Explore all of the Everglades-style region 17. Beach Bum: Visit every major beach in Leonida 18. Night Life: Enter every major nightclub in Vice City 19. Strip Club Regular: Visit all strip clubs 20. High Roller: Win $1,000,000 at the casino 21. Broke and Famous: Lose $500,000 at the casino 22. Cartel Connections: Complete all cartel-related side missions 23. Street Hustler: Complete 20 random street crimes
24. The Collector: Find 50 hidden packages or collectibles 25. Treasure Hunter: Find all hidden packages 26. Stunt Junkie: Complete 25 unique jumps 27. All Stunts Complete: Complete every unique jump 28. Speed Demon: Reach 200mph in any vehicle 29. Air Superiority: Fly under 10 bridges with an aircraft 30. Boat Life: Drive a boat for 50 miles 31. Wrecking Ball: Destroy 100 vehicles
32. Wanted: Level 5: Survive a five-star wanted level for five minutes 33. Escape Artist: Lose a five-star wanted level 34. Sharpshooter: Kill 50 enemies with headshots 35. Melee Master: Kill 25 enemies with melee weapons 36. Explosive Personality: Kill 20 enemies with explosives 37. Stealth Operator: Complete five missions without being detected
38. Property Mogul: Own all available properties 39. Business Empire: Fully upgrade every business 40. Taxi Driver: Complete 20 taxi fares 41. Delivery Boy: Complete 15 delivery side jobs 42. Paramedic: Complete 10 ambulance missions 43. Firestarter: Complete 10 firefighter missions
44. Wildlife Photographer: Photograph 15 different animals 45. Alligator Wrangler: Kill 10 alligators 46. Manatee Protector: Avoid hitting 20 manatees while boating 47. Party Animal: Get wasted at 10 different locations 48. Fashion Icon: Change outfits 50 times
49. Car Collector: Own 50 unique vehicles 50. Hangar Owner: Own 10 aircraft 51. Marina Master: Own 10 boats 52. Full Arsenal: Purchase every weapon 53. Maxed Out: Reach maximum stats for both protagonists 54. 100% Completionist: Achieve 100% completion 55. Vice City Legend: Unlock every other trophy (Platinum)
Some entries fit what we already know about GTA 6. Jason and Lucia are both playable, and Leonida is based on Florida, so swamps, alligators and beaches all make sense. Likewise, “Florida Man” feels like an obvious joke for a game set in a parody of the Sunshine State.
Other entries echo long-running GTA traditions, such as unique stunt jumps, hidden packages, taxi fares and ambulance missions. The strip club trophy would also fit a series known for its strange strip club details .
At this stage, there’s good reason to doubt it. The list comes from unnamed sources on social media, and Rockstar hasn’t confirmed anything. On the PSNProfiles forum , where trophy hunters track upcoming lists, users have already labelled it “probably fake”.
There are several red flags, too. Recent GTA games haven’t offered difficulty settings, which makes a “hard difficulty” trophy look out of place. Some challenges, like avoiding 20 manatees while boating, also seem oddly specific and hard for a game to track.
Most importantly, the believable entries mostly reflect details anyone could take from the trailers and recent previews . That makes a convincing fake fairly easy to put together.
Thankfully, there won’t be long to wait. Trophy and achievement lists usually appear on PlayStation and Xbox shortly before or at launch. GTA 6 arrives on November 19, so the real list should surface very soon.
